title: Russian-Style Beef Stew
description: A hearty, comforting Indian-inspired beef stew recipe with a rich, thick sauce. This dish is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: 1. Heat the peanut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
3. Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the stew, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
5. Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
7. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
